agent_data_note: Use real CI recheck data from OpenStack Gerrit or another authentic source. Do **not** use synthetic/sample CSV files from seeds (e.g. sample_rechecks.csv).
benchmark_rules: Use scikit-learn / pandas / numpy / statsmodels only. Do **not** use PyTorch.
Use temporal train/test splits; no leakage from future recheck outcomes into features.
Forbidden: inventing or loading synthetic pilot CSVs under dataset_candidate/.
If real OpenStack data is unavailable, document the blocker; do not substitute fake data.
non_goals: Using sample_rechecks.csv or other seed pilot files as evaluation data
Crawling the full 10-year OpenStack Gerrit API in this benchmark run unless scoped
Using test logs or source code of individual tests as features
